ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Apoorva Leasing Finance & Investment Co. Ltd.'s statutory auditors, M/s Singhal & Gupta, have resigned effective September 4, 2026, significantly curtailing their scheduled five-year term. While the stated reasons are "commercial considerations and changes in our firm's professional priorities" with no disclosed audit concerns or information issues, this early departure necessitates the prompt appointment of new auditors and may raise questions regarding the company's financial oversight.
